visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee wearing a blue-grey worker's jumpsuit and a denim cap stands in a dark studio environment. He gestures expressively with his hands while speaking directly to the camera, illuminated by bright, soft frontal lighting that highlights his facial features and the texture of his uniform against the matte black cabinetry. (2) A screen capture overlay displaying the Kickstarter website appears, showcasing various project thumbnails and crowdfunding metrics. The man continues to speak off-camera while the visual focuses on the digital interface, which shows tech-oriented products and financial goal progress bars in a clear, high-resolution layout. (3) The scene shifts to the man pointing toward a compact, silver and black box-shaped machine identified as a eufyMake E1 UV printer. The machine sits on a dark countertop under studio lights, and the man uses broad hand motions to indicate its size and placement within his workspace. (4) A close-up view of the UV printer's interior reveals a mechanical arm moving horizontally while emitting a bright purple UV light over a white substrate. The arm's movement is precise, and the internal components of the printer are shown in detail, demonstrating the physical printing process on a flat surface. (5) A sequence of close-up shots displays finished printed items including small decorative tiles with intricate 3D floral patterns and a crown. The lighting emphasizes the tangible texture and depth of the ink layers, while the man's hand occasionally enters the frame to hold the objects for closer inspection. (6) The man holds a black cylindrical container while demonstrating a rotary attachment for the printer. The camera captures his hands mounting the cylinder onto the roller mechanism, which then begins to rotate as the UV light prints a white logo onto its dark surface in a well-lit workshop setting. (7) A final montage shows various material samples such as marble, wood, and leather with printed textures. The man stands back in the original eye-level shot, clapping his hands together to introduce a large red "88分" graphic overlay as the video concludes in the studio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce and review the eufyMake E1 UV printer, highlighting its record-breaking crowdfunding success on Kickstarter. It demonstrates the product's unique selling points such as AI-driven 3D texture generation, compact size, affordability, and versatility in printing on various materials like glass, leather, and ceramics.
